question: Identify charter schools in districts whose names start with 'San' that have an SAT excellence rate above the average excellence rate of all locally funded charter schools. Return their charter numbers, school names, and rank them by their writing scores in descending order.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    s.XCL_064 AS charter_number,
    s.XCL_047 AS school_name
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS sat ON s.XCL_041 = sat.XCL_030
JOIN frpm AS f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
WHERE s.XCL_063 = 1
  AND s.XCL_046 LIKE 'San%'
  AND (CAST(sat.XCL_040 AS REAL) / sat.XCL_036) > (
      SELECT AVG(CAST(sat2.XCL_040 AS REAL) / sat2.XCL_036)
      FROM schools AS s2
      JOIN satscores AS sat2 ON s2.XCL_041 = sat2.XCL_030
      JOIN frpm AS f2 ON s2.XCL_041 = f2.XCL_001
      WHERE s2.XCL_063 = 1
        AND f2.XCL_015 = 'Locally funded'
  )
ORDER BY sat.XCL_039 DESC

  )
ORDER BY sat.XCL_039 DESC
